title: Controllable and Content-Based Recommendations
abstract: arXiv:2607.20938v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Traditional recommendation systems rely on latent (dense) representations, making them difficult to interpret and control. We propose the Controllable and Content-Based Recommendations (CCBR) framework, which builds its recommendations from textual user profile representations. CCBR plugs into collaborative filtering models and introduces controllability via text bottlenecks. We show that CCBR enables text-based and multimodal interventions, allowing users to steer the model towards the directions they prefer. Different from existing controllable recommendation systems, CCBR infers the text summaries directly from item contents (images, audio or video). Across image, audio, and video datasets, we demonstrate that the proposed framework obtains competitive model performance with standard (latent-representation) models while providing controllable model summaries via text. The model also outperforms TEARS, a recent baseline for control

translated_title: 可控的基于内容的推荐系统
translated_abstract: 传统推荐系统依赖于潜在（稠密）表示，这使得它们难以解释和控制。我们提出了可控且基于内容的推荐框架（CCBR），该框架基于文本用户画像表示来构建推荐。CCBR可嵌入协同过滤模型中，并通过文本瓶颈引入可控性。我们展示了CCBR支持基于文本和多模态的干预，允许用户将模型引导向他们偏好的方向。与现有的可控推荐系统不同，CCBR直接从物品内容（图像、音频或视频）推断文本摘要。在图像、音频和视频数据集上，我们证明了所提出的框架在获得与标准（潜在表示）模型相当的性能的同时，还能通过文本提供可控的模型摘要。该模型还优于TEARS——一个近期的可控推荐基线。
tldr: 该论文提出了CCBR框架，通过文本瓶颈将协同过滤与直接从物品多模态内容（图像、音频、视频）推断出的文本用户画像相结合，在保持与标准潜在表示模型相当性能的同时，实现了可通过文本干预进行控制的可解释推荐。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes CCBR, a framework that plugs into collaborative filtering models and infers textual user profiles directly from item contents (images, audio, video) via text bottlenecks, achieving competitive performance while enabling controllable, text-based recommendations.
